title: [v6.1] Omit unlimited pids limit for rootless cgroupfs
body:
Cherry-pick of #29910 commit.

```
Rootless with the cgroupfs manager the pids controller is often not delegated, as on WSL machines. The default path already skips the pids limit there, but an explicit unlimited value (--pids-limit -1 or 0, the PidsLimit=0 every Docker client sends, or pids.limit 0 on the libpod API) still reached crun, which then failed with "controller `pids` is not available".

A new cgroup has no pids limit anyway, so drop an unlimited limit in that case. Finite limits are left as they are.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/29909

(cherry picked from commit f41dc744b2e02979f11c21664663d08534acd936)
```
